info.title: EDUNEXUS API
info.description: Sections 1 through 2B.3: staff/school setup, learner registry/enrollment, roster imports, LRN and timeline corrections, and reviewed reversible identity links. Managers make changes; teachers read current assigned learners only. Linked profiles remain manager-readable but frozen; normal lists return retained profiles. Enrollment learner_id identifies the retained profile, while recorded_learner_id preserves original ownership. Identity links never reparent or delete enrollment history; assigned source LRNs and overlapping enrollment years block reconciliation. Effective timelines include corrections, while /history explicitly returns original movements. All review commits require current versions, unchanged context, a reason and explicit confirmation. Closed-year enrollment dates/state remain immutable. Imports use the EDUNEXUS template with stored preview/commit receipts. Attendance, grades, promotion, official forms, enrollment cancellation and conflicting-year reconciliation remain unimplemented. Supabase bearer authentication and deployed MFA are required. Calendar dates are YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Manila; timestamps are UTC. JSON bodies are limited to 32 KiB, except timeline preview/correction POST routes (256 KiB/1000 entries).
